title: Action confirm dialog ignores the bundle's translated confirmText — label from the SAME entry is applied, confirmText is not
body:
## Symptom (zh-CN console, HotCRM main `333259a4`, @objectstack/console 17.0.0-rc.5)

HotCRM's zh-CN bundle translates the `convert_lead` action completely:

```ts
convert_lead: {
  label: '转化线索',              // ← applied: the button renders 转化线索
  confirmText: '确认要转化此线索吗？', // ← IGNORED
  successMessage: '线索转化成功！',
},
```

Clicking the (correctly translated) 转化线索 button opens the confirm dialog with the console's own chrome in Chinese (title 确认操作, buttons 取消/继续) but the body in authored English: **"Are you sure you want to convert this lead?"** — the `confirmText` from `src/actions/lead.actions.ts`, not the bundle's translation.

Same entry, two fates: `label` goes through translation resolution, `confirmText` reaches the dialog untranslated. The actions surface of TranslationBundle explicitly carries `confirmText`, so the metadata contract says this should work.

## Expected

The confirm dialog body resolves `actions.<name>.confirmText` from the active locale's bundle exactly like `label` does (and presumably `successMessage` on the toast wants checking too).

## Repro

zh-CN console → HotCRM → any unconverted lead → click 转化线索 → dialog body is English while its button was Chinese.
